verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਗਵਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਹਰੇ ਨ ਭਏ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sun piray gavan sravan bahare na bhe kaahe kee patibrataa pat brat paayo hai ||

en.bdb: Why did my ears not turn deaf hearing the departure of my dear beloved? What type of faithful and loyal wife am I and what sort of husband-engrossed religion (life style) have I acquired?

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਧਰੇ ਨ ਭਏ ਨੈਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਹੂੰ ਲਜਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirashaT piray agochar hui a(n)dhare na bhe nain kaahe kee premanee prem hoo(n) lajaayo hai ||

en.bdb: Why did I not go blind when my beloved was disappearing from my vision? What sort of beloved am I ? I have shamed the love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਧਿ ਬਿਹਾਏ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਲਖਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: avadh bihaae dhai dhai birahaa biaapai kaahe kee birahanee bireh bilakhaayo hai ||

en.bdb: My life is waning and the separation of my Lord is chasing me and causing me distress. What type of separation is this? The pangs of separations have made me restless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਨਾਹਿ ਫੂਟਿਯੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਗਨਉ ਚੂਕ ਉੱਤਰ ਨ ਆਯੋ ਹੈ ॥੬੬੭॥
verses.translit_en: sunat bidhes ke sa(n)dhes naeh fooTiyo ridhaa kaun kaun ganau chook u'tar na aayo hai ||667||

en.bdb: Why has my heart not burst, receiving the message that my dear beloved will stay away from me in other place? What all blunders made may I count and recall, I have no answer of it.  (667)
